blocks.heading: Aerospace Technical Documentation LLM
paragraphs: For Lockheed Martin Space (Littleton CO), United Launch Alliance (Centennial CO), Raytheon Intelligence & Space (Aurora CO), and Denver's Space Corridor:

Engineering documentation assistant: Self-hosted Llama 3 deployed on corporate infrastructure for Lockheed's and ULA's commercial engineering teams — querying technical specifications, manufacturing procedures, and system engineering documentation without aerospace IP leaving the corporate network. Self-hosted deployment is the standard approach for Denver aerospace clients where data sovereignty is non-negotiable.
Supply chain document intelligence: LLM for aerospace supply chain managers querying supplier qualification documentation, AS9100 quality records, and procurement specification libraries.

Commercial space operations knowledge: LLM for ULA's commercial launch services operations — querying launch procedure documentation, mission planning references, and customer integration specifications for ULA's commercial satellite customers.
Cost: $25,000–$85,000 | Timeline: 8–18 weeks | Self-hosted standard

blocks.heading: Energy Operations Knowledge Management
paragraphs: For Xcel Energy (Denver HQ), Civitas Resources (Denver), and the Colorado energy community:

Grid operations knowledge: Azure OpenAI for Xcel Energy's grid operations teams — querying NERC reliability standards, FERC tariff requirements, and operational procedures for Xcel's large Colorado and Upper Midwest transmission and distribution network.

Renewable energy operational LLM: LLM for the solar and wind operations teams managing Xcel's growing Colorado renewable portfolio — querying turbine maintenance procedures, inverter technical specifications, and operations manuals for the diverse renewable technology portfolio.

Oil and gas technical LLM: Self-hosted LLM for Denver's DJ Basin operators (Civitas Resources, Bonanza Creek) — querying completion engineering documentation, well operations procedures, and regulatory compliance references for Colorado's O&G regulatory framework.
Cost: $25,000–$80,000 | Timeline: 8–18 weeks | FERC, NERC, COGCC context

blocks.heading: Healthcare Clinical LLM
paragraphs: For UCHealth, Centura/Intermountain Colorado, and Denver's major health systems:

Clinical documentation assistance: Claude 3.5 Sonnet via AWS Bedrock for UCHealth's large ambulatory care documentation — converting physician-patient encounter audio to structured Epic notes with Colorado's altitude-aware clinical parameters in mind.

Clinical protocol intelligence: LLM for UCHealth's clinical staff querying evidence-based protocols and Colorado-specific clinical guidelines — including altitude-adjusted clinical parameters that other US health system LLMs don't incorporate.

Colorado AI Act compliance: LLM applications in healthcare are covered by Colorado's SB24-205 AI Act if they are high-risk automated decision systems — ClickMasters designs Denver healthcare LLM with Colorado AI Act impact assessment requirements.
Cost: $25,000–$85,000 | Timeline: 8–18 weeks | HIPAA + Colorado AI Act

blocks.heading: Government Technology LLM
paragraphs: For Colorado Department of Technology (OIT) and Colorado state agencies:
State employee knowledge systems: LLM over Colorado state policies, procedures, and regulatory guidance for Colorado's large state government workforce.

Colorado AI Act compliance management: LLM for Colorado state agencies navigating the complex requirements of Colorado's AI legislation — querying the AI Act's requirements, impact assessment frameworks, and disclosure obligations.
Cost: $20,000–$70,000 | Timeline: 8–16 weeks | Colorado AI Act

sections.title: Denver LLM Technical Context
sections.description: Key considerations for LLM integration in Denver.

blocks.heading: Self-hosted as aerospace default
paragraphs: Denver's aerospace community will not transmit engineering data to external LLM APIs. ClickMasters deploys Llama 3 70B on corporate infrastructure for all Denver aerospace LLM — this is non-negotiable and is ClickMasters' standard recommendation for this client segment.

blocks.heading: Colorado AI Act compliance
paragraphs: Colorado's SB24-205 creates disclosure and impact assessment requirements for high-risk AI systems — LLM applications in high-stakes decision contexts (healthcare, employment, housing, lending) in Colorado must meet Colorado AI Act standards. ClickMasters designs Denver LLM with Colorado AI Act compliance from the architecture phase.

blocks.heading: Azure OpenAI for Colorado's Microsoft ecosystem
paragraphs: Lockheed Martin and the other Denver aerospace companies are heavily Microsoft-standardized — but aerospace data sensitivity means Azure OpenAI within the corporate Azure tenant is the preferred deployment path over OpenAI's API for these clients.
